A '''First Order Raider''' was part of a [[Raith's squad|squad]] led by [[Agent]] [[Raith]] that pursued the [[archaeologist]] [[Mika Grey]] to [[Ashas Ree]]. They helped arrest [[Kazuda Xiono]] and his colleagues while on world, shoving the children Kel and Eila harshly to keep them moving alongside their [[Unidentified First Order Raider 2|counterpart]].<ref name="TRR" />
